description:
Hold a key, speak, and let go: VibeScribe types your words wherever your cursor is. Speech is transcribed on your Mac with Whisper, so your voice never leaves it.

No account. No cloud. No subscription. Audio is processed in memory and is never saved or sent anywhere.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Click where you want to write: an email, a document, a chat, a prompt for your AI coding agent.
2. Hold Right Option (⌥) and speak.
3. Let go. The text is pasted into the app you're using.

VibeScribe lives in the menu bar and stays out of the way until you need it.
• Tap the key instead to go hands-free for longer passages, and tap again to finish. Press Esc to throw a recording away.
• A small overlay below the menu bar shows Listening, Hands-free or Transcribing, then how it ended: Pasted with a word count, Copied, or No speech heard.
• Hold the key and say nothing, and nothing is pasted. No invented filler text in your documents.
• After pasting, VibeScribe puts back whatever was on your clipboard.

FOR WORDS THAT SHOULDN'T BE UPLOADED
Case notes, patient notes, HR conversations, board memos, plans for things that haven't shipped. Many dictation services send your voice to a server to be transcribed. There is no VibeScribe server. The speech model runs on your Mac's Apple silicon, so no one else hears what you say, including us.

WHAT STAYS ON YOUR MAC
• Your audio. It's transcribed in memory and discarded, never written to disk.
• Your words. Text goes to the app you're typing in, or to your clipboard. Nowhere else.
• Your history. Kept on your Mac so text pasted into the wrong window is never lost. Search it, copy an entry or paste it again. Keep it for 1, 7 or 30 days or forever, or turn it off. Clear it any time.
• Recording happens only while you hold the key or dictate hands-free, and the menu bar icon turns colorful only while it does.
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads. VibeScribe goes online only to download its speech models from Hugging Face, and it verifies every file with a SHA-256 checksum.

WORKS OFFLINE
Once the model is downloaded, VibeScribe needs no internet connection. Dictate on a plane, on a locked-down network, or with Wi-Fi off.

100 LANGUAGES
• Press Option-Shift (⌥⇧) anywhere to search 100 languages by English or native name, or leave it on Automatic to detect the language for you.
• Pin up to three languages and switch between them with ⌘1–⌘3 in the picker, or from the menu bar.
• Add names, product terms and jargon to your vocabulary to help the model spell them your way.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Keep Right Option or record your own shortcut. Hold to talk, tap for hands-free, or both.
• Pick a microphone and watch its input level.
• Paste into the active app, or copy to the clipboard only.
• Pause the shortcut from the menu bar during games or screen sharing.

TWO WHISPER MODELS
• Whisper large-v3: the most accurate. Downloaded on first launch.
• Whisper large-v3 turbo: roughly 3× faster, slightly less accurate in less common languages. An optional download in Settings that runs in the background while you keep dictating.

REQUIREMENTS
• A Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14 Sonoma or later.
• A one-time download of about 630 MB for the speech model. You can pause it, and it resumes on its own if your connection drops. Preparing the model for your Mac takes about a minute the first time.
• Three permissions, each explained during setup:
  – Microphone, to hear you.
  – Input Monitoring, so your shortcut works in every app.
  – Accessibility, to paste for you. Without it, VibeScribe copies the text and you press ⌘V.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
VibeScribe is free, with no subscription, no in-app purchases and no ads. Its source code is public under the MIT license at github.com/flatoy/vibescribe, so you can check exactly what happens to your voice.
promotionalText: Hold a key, speak, let go: your words appear wherever you type, transcribed privately on your Mac in 100 languages. No account, no cloud, no subscription. Free.
